encoding: opaque byte payload framed by LF; optional CR before LF removed; final nonempty EOF frame allowed
oversize: terminal refusal; no drain, partial reinterpretation or replay
pendingReservation: whole maximum frame before serialization; count and bytes reserved until write completion or failure
logicalSession: explicit rebind to a new open connection after old connection closed or failed; sequence survives
sequence: checked unsigned 64-bit; no saturation; not application operation or state revision
connection: one physical stream lifecycle; Rust stdin and stdout are separately owned directional pipes
deliveryReceipt: local-write completion only; not peer acknowledgement

http.request: method, exact URL, headers, optional bounded body, timeout and buffered response ceiling
http.wirePreparation: JSON serialization and optional Zstd compression occur once; retries reuse exact bytes
http.loopbackCallback: one finite GET for localhost or 127.0.0.1 at an explicitly selected port

receipts.CommandReceipt: application command admission owner, not minted here
receipts.ExecutionReceipt: application execution owner, not minted here
receipts.ProviderReceipt: external effect owner, not minted here
receipts.CommitReceipt: storage commit owner, not minted here

authorization: none; identification, heartbeat and delivery do not authorize
recovery: application owner supplies exact current references and snapshot; no automatic retransmission, latest-ref rebinding or provider incarnation replacement
